desc: Ideation: select the threshold/binary-search approach using per-vitamin capacity knapsack over calories.
Implement the complete Python solution: input parsing, per-vitamin 0/1 knapsack DP with at-most semantics, prefix maxima, feasibility via bisect_left, binary search over target, and output.
Verify correctness and edge cases: missing vitamin type, T=0, insufficient budget, large vitamin amounts, disjoint vitamin food sets, and sample tests.
